title: The best player in the world sent it over the bar: Roberto Baggio, the 1994 World Cup final
post:
17 July 1994, the Rose Bowl, Pasadena: Brazil and Italy play 120 minutes without a goal, and for the first time a World Cup final goes to penalties. Italy's last kick belongs to Roberto Baggio, the world player of the year. He aims for the middle; the ball goes over the bar, and Brazil win their fourth World Cup.

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; the settings of plea2005 (STYLE_BIBLE rule 68)

phrases.text: The best player in the world. One penalty to keep a World Cup final alive. He sent it over the bar. His name? Roberto Baggio.
phrases.say: [grave] The best player in the world. ... One penalty, to keep a World Cup final alive. ... He sent it over the bar. ... His name? ... Roberto Baggio.

phrases.text: July 17, 1994. Pasadena, a hundred degrees. Brazil against Italy, and Baggio plays with an injured hamstring.
phrases.say: July seventeenth, nineteen ninety-four. Pasadena, a hundred degrees. Brazil against Italy... [quietly] and Baggio plays with an injured hamstring.

phrases.text: Two hours, no goals. For the first time, a World Cup final goes to penalties.
phrases.say: Two hours... no goals. [building] For the first time, a World Cup final goes to penalties.

phrases.text: Baresi: over the bar. Márcio Santos: saved. Then four goals in a row. Taffarel saves from Massaro. Dunga scores. 3–2, Brazil.
phrases.say: [tense] Baresi: over the bar. Marcio Santos: saved. Then four goals in a row. Taffarel saves from Massaro. Dunga scores. ... Three–two, Brazil.

phrases.text: Italy's last kick: Baggio. He knows Taffarel always dives, so he aims for the middle. Taffarel dives. The ball flies over the bar.
phrases.say: Italy's last kick: ... Baggio. He knows Taffarel always dives, so he aims for the middle. ... Taffarel dives. ... [quietly] The ball flies over the bar.

phrases.text: Brazil are world champions for the fourth time. And Baggio stays at the spot, alone, head down. Years later he said: if I could erase a moment from my career, it would be that one.
phrases.say: [warmly] Brazil are world champions for the fourth time. ... [quietly] And Baggio stays at the spot... alone... head down. ... Years later he said: if I could erase a moment from my career... it would be that one.
